lr-cov.label: Share of 2018–2026 deliveries with both batters' hands known
lr-cov.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (7,12) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_t, sb.name s, nb.name ns, d.total_runs r, CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END b, CASE WHEN dm.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END w FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players sb ON sb.player_id = d.batter_id JOIN players nb ON nb.player_id = d.non_striker_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2018
